With offices in Bangladesh, Hong Kong, China, and the UAE, the company connects international brands with reliable manufacturing partners across Asia. Source Asia HK Ltd. focuses on high-quality products, competitive pricing, ethical manufacturing, and dependable logistics. Through strong supplier relationships and deep market knowledge, the company turns client concepts into market-ready products while ensuring compliance and timely delivery. It continues to expand capabilities in sourcing, product development, quality assurance, and logistics, maintaining a commitment to transparency, sustainability, and integrity. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement marketing strategies to promote our readymade garments across global markets. Conduct market research and analysis to identify new opportunities and tailor product offerings to meet market demands. Manage relationships with international clients, ensuring excellent service and satisfaction. Attend international trade shows and exhibitions to showcase our products and expand our market presence. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in other languages is a plus. Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field. Job Summary: Employment Status: Full-time Job Location: Hong Kong Salary: Attractive salary package, commensurate with experience Compensation & Other Benefits: Competitive salary Yearly salary review Festival bonuses Excellent working environment Opportunities for professional growth and development Application Process: Interested candidates please send your CV by 20th October, 2026 to career@sourceasiahk.com

review_candidates.title: International Property Management Specialist
review_candidates.description: International PMS Junior / Specialist The Employee/Consultant shall perform the duties and responsibilities associated with the position of International PMS Junior / Specialist/Senior and shall undertake such other duties as may reasonably be assigned by the Company in connection with the Company's hospitality technology, Property Management System (PMS), implementation, support, and related services. The Employee/Consultant's duties and responsibilities shall include, but shall not be limited to, the following: 1. PMS Implementation and Deployment 1.1. Install, configure, deploy, test, implement, and support Property Management Systems (PMS) at hotel properties in accordance with approved project requirements, implementation plans, and Company standards. 1.2. Implement, configure, and support PMS solutions for local and international hotel clients, ensuring that the systems are appropriately aligned with the operational, technical, and business requirements of each property. 1.3. Participate in and support new hotel openings, PMS upgrades, system migrations, rollouts, implementations, enhancements, and customer-request projects. 1.4. Perform onsite and remote implementation activities as required by the Company, project requirements, customer requirements, or assigned work schedules. 1.5. Review and analyze client requirements and translate such requirements into appropriate PMS configurations and system solutions in accordance with approved specifications. 1.6. Ensure that all PMS implementation and deployment activities are performed in accordance with applicable Company policies, project standards, approved procedures, customer requirements, and relevant hospitality industry standards. 2. PMS Configuration and Testing 2.1. Configure PMS modules, parameters, users, security profiles, operational settings, and other system components in accordance with approved business and technical requirements. 2.2. Perform system configuration verification, testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure that the PMS operates correctly and supports the required hotel business processes. 2.3. Participate in and support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), pre-go-live testing, and other testing activities as required. 2.4. Identify, investigate, and document configuration, functional, and technical issues and coordinate with the relevant internal or external teams to facilitate their resolution. 2.5. Perform the required system readiness activities prior to hotel go-live and ensure that assigned PMS tasks are completed within the approved project timeline. 2.6. Support configuration changes, enhancements, and system updates in accordance with the Company's change management and quality assurance procedures. 3. PMS Interfaces and System Integrations 3.1. Configure, test, monitor, and support PMS interfaces and integrations with third-party hotel systems and applications. 3.2. Support the establishment and maintenance of appropriate connectivity and data exchange between the PMS and integrated systems. 3.3. Coordinate with interface teams, technical teams, vendors, third-party solution providers, and other relevant stakeholders to investigate and resolve interface and integration-related issues. 3.4. Perform interface testing, validation, and troubleshooting as part of implementation, upgrade, migration, and go-live activities. 3.5. Monitor assigned interface-related issues and ensure that such issues are appropriately documented, escalated, followed up, and resolved within the applicable project timelines or agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). 4. Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management 4.1. Work collaboratively with hotel IT teams, hotel operational users, Project Managers, technical teams, interface teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to support the successful delivery of PMS projects. 4.2. Coordinate with relevant internal departments and project teams to facilitate the timely and effective implementation, integration, testing, and deployment of PMS solutions. 4.3. Attend, participate in, and where required lead or facilitate project meetings, technical discussions, status meetings, and implementation sessions relevant to assigned responsibilities. 4.4. Provide timely and accurate updates regarding assigned activities, project progress, outstanding issues, risks, dependencies, and required actions. 4.5. Collaborate with functional, technical, and support teams to investigate and resolve implementation-related challenges. 4.6. Maintain effective and professional communication with hotel stakeholders, customers, internal teams, vendors, and other parties involved in assigned projects. 5. Customer Support and Incident Management 5.1. Provide PMS support to hotel clients during implementation, go-live, post-implementation, and ongoing operational support activities as assigned. 5.2. Monitor assigned system issues and proactively identify and address problems that may impact hotel operations or system availability. 5.3. Analyze reported incidents, investigate their causes, and provide appropriate solutions, corrective actions, or temporary workarounds within the scope of the Employee's/Consultant's responsibilities. 5.4. Accurately record all customer cases, incidents, activities, actions, resolutions, and relevant information in the Company's designated CRM or case-management system. 5.5. Ensure that assigned customer cases are appropriately followed up, updated, resolved, documented, and closed within the applicable SLA and Company procedures. 5.6. Escalate complex, critical, or unresolved issues to the appropriate technical, functional, management, vendor, or third-party teams in accordance with established escalation procedures. 5.7. Maintain professional, timely, and appropriate communication with customers throughout the incident investigation and resolution process. 6. Documentation and Knowledge Management 6.1. Prepare, maintain, and update accurate project, implementation, configuration, testing, and support documentation as required. 6.2. Documentation may include, but shall not be limited to: Implementation plans; Configuration documents and workbooks; Testing and validation documents; Interface and integration documentation; Deployment and installation checklists; Go-live and cutover documentation; Troubleshooting and support guides; Handover and knowledge-transfer documents; and Other technical or functional documentation required by the Company or project. 6.3. Ensure that all relevant implementation, configuration, testing, support, and troubleshooting activities are appropriately documented and maintained in the designated Company systems or repositories. 6.4. Prepare and maintain technical and functional reference materials, procedures, guides, and knowledge-base documents as required. 6.5. Share relevant knowledge, experience, technical information, and best practices with other members of the PMS and Hospitality Technology teams. 7. Technology Development and Continuous Learning 7.1. Maintain current knowledge of PMS technologies, hospitality technology solutions, system enhancements, integration technologies, and relevant industry developments. 7.2. Keep up to date with new PMS releases, features, functionality, interfaces, integrations, and related technologies applicable to the Company's services and customer environments. 7.3. Participate in relevant training programs, workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions, product updates, and professional development activities as directed by the Company. 7.4. Evaluate and familiarize themselves with new technologies, tools, and solutions relevant to PMS implementation and support activities. 7.5. Prepare technical and functional reference documents, knowledge materials, or implementation guidelines relating to new technologies and solutions where required. 7.6. Continuously develop and maintain the technical, functional, and hospitality knowledge necessary to perform the position effectively. 8. Compliance, Quality, and Security 8.1. Perform all PMS implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and support activities in compliance with Company policies, procedures, standards, and approved methodologies. 8.2. Ensure that assigned activities comply with approved project requirements, customer requirements, applicable hospitality industry standards, and relevant contractual obligations. 8.3. Comply with all applicable information security, system access, user security, data protection, confidentiality, and access-control requirements. 8.4. Follow the Company's established quality assurance, change management, incident management, documentation, and escalation procedures. 8.5. Ensure that system changes and configuration modifications are appropriately authorized, tested, documented, and implemented in accordance with approved procedures. 8.6. Protect the confidentiality and security of all customer, hotel, Company, system, configuration, and business information accessed or handled during the performance of assigned duties. 8.7. Promptly report any security incident, system risk, data issue, unauthorized access, or other matter that may adversely affect the Company's or customer's systems or operations. 9. International Assignments and Mobility 9.1. The Employee/Consultant may be required, based on business and project requirements, to perform duties at customer locations, hotel properties, Company offices, or other designated locations within or outside the Employee's/Consultant's country of residence. 9.2. The Employee/Consultant shall be reasonably available to undertake domestic or international travel associated with PMS implementations, hotel openings, migrations, upgrades, go-live activities, customer support, training, or other project requirements, subject to applicable Company policies and contractual terms.

Salaris tussen €3.500 en €4.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring Fulltime functie van 40 uur per week Direct in dienst bij de opdrachtgever 28 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld Een eigen internationale klantenportefeuille Ondersteuning van een sales assistant Mogelijkheid om klanten en beurzen in het buitenland te bezoeken Ruimte om jezelf commercieel verder te ontwikkelen Uitzicht op een vast dienstverband Functie-eisen Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die commercieel sterk is, makkelijk contact legt en verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen. review_candidates.description: Company Description Private VIP Residence (UHNWI) is a high-end household that maintains exceptionally high standards of cleanliness, discretion, and service. The residence is managed by a professional team that supports the daily life and comfort of an ultra-high-net-worth individual and their guests. Staff members are expected to deliver reliable, detail-oriented service while respecting privacy and confidentiality at all times. Teamwork, trustworthiness, and a commitment to excellence are central to the working environment. The residence offers a structured, well-organized setting for experienced household professionals. Role Description The Housekeeper role is a full-time, on-site position based in Dubai. The Housekeeper is responsible for daily cleaning and maintenance of all living areas, including bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, and common spaces, ensuring they are kept to an immaculate standard. Typical tasks include dusting, vacuuming, mopping, polishing surfaces, making beds, and replenishing household supplies. The role involves handling laundry and wardrobe care, including washing, ironing, steaming, folding, and organizing clothing and linens. The Housekeeper may assist with turn-down service, preparation of guest rooms, light meal prep support, and coordination with other household staff to ensure smooth daily operations. Discretion, reliability, and the ability to follow detailed instructions and household protocols are essential. Qualifications Strong housekeeping and organization skills, with attention to detail and the ability to maintain high cleanliness standards. Proficiency in laundry care, including washing, ironing, steaming, and proper handling of delicate and luxury fabrics. Effective communication and customer service skills to interact professionally with principals, guests, and other staff. Experience in training or mentoring other housekeeping staff, and willingness to follow and uphold established household procedures. Previous experience in luxury residences, five-star hotels, or similar high-end environments is highly beneficial. Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise discretion, and respect the privacy of the household at all times. Physical stamina to perform housekeeping tasks throughout the day and flexibility to accommodate changing schedules. Basic English language skills; additional languages are an advantage.
